messages:
alex: heads-up — i'm planning a small micro-cohort canary for feature `slice-routing` today at 17:30 UTC. plan: 2% -> 10% over ~45m with checks at 2%, 5%, and 10%. cohorts: eu-west (sampled 3% of eu traffic) and us-east (2% of us traffic). need a deploy owner + smoke checker. thresholds: errors >0.5% OR p95 latency +200ms => rollback. who can take deploy?

maria: i can take deploy ownership. i'll be at my desk from 17:15 and can start the window. i'll announce start + finish in this thread. :rocket:

ken: i'll run smoke checks. i'll follow the smoke checklist (health, 5 sample requests, top-level metrics, quick logs). put me in pager if any rate errors spike.

sam: quick config Q — are we using the traffic-shaper for cohort pinning or just header-based slice routing? if header-based we should add a short TTL to avoid sticky sessions.

alex: header-based with short ttl (30s). sam good catch. i'll add the TTL in the rollout config. snippet i'm planning to push:

```
rollout:
  mode: header
  header: X-Canary-Group
  cohort_ttl_s: 30
  steps: [2, 5, 10]
  check_interval_s: 900
```

sam: looks good. also add the fallback-variant key so runtime can auto-fallback to v2 if needed.

maria: pre-deploy checklist done: feature flags enabled in staging, integration smoke passed, canary profile created (micro-crest-5099). i'm ready to hit the button at 17:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary 'micro-crest-5099' for 2026-03-18T17:30:00Z (thread: 5099998765). preflight checks: ok. ticket: RDW-1234.

dylan: i'll monitor infra side — GPU pool scaling, queue depth, and token service latency. i'll post immediate alerts if queue depth > 80% or token latency > 1200ms.

ken: smoke checklist (short):
- /health OK on 5 hosts
- sample gen: 10 short completions take <300ms median
- error rate <0.2% for 5m after step
- sample rerank responses correct shape

maria: starting canary now (17:30). marking step 1 -> 2% on eu-west/us-east. will ping when step is stable.

deploy-bot: canary step 1 deployed (2%). monitoring hooks active.

ken: doing smoke now — /health ok, 10 samples passed, median latency 260ms, error rate 0.05%. all good from smoke.

maria: advancing to 5% in 5m.

deploy-bot: canary step 2 deployed (5%).

dylan: infra metrics: queue depth 42%, token svc p95 820ms, no scaling events.

ken: smoke after step 2: 10 samples ok, no error spike, p95 ~295ms. good to go to 10%.

maria: advancing to 10% now.

deploy-bot: canary step 3 deployed (10%). starting 20m stability window.

alex: awesome — thanks all. if nothing wobbles we'll mark complete at end of stability window and promote rollout. if any checks fail, rollback plan: immediate abort + switch traffic back to previous variant (deploy-bot command: `rollback micro-crest-5099`) and open incident channel with SRE.

maria: noted. i'll close thread with final status when stability window ends. :white_check_mark:
